name: Barron
source:
"If you fuck you'll get feelings, right?"

An inhabitant of "The End", he is a forceful and lustful older man.
One of the players of the game It is participating in.
His motto is that "love does not need time."
Although he appears to be the oldest, he is actually the newest inhabitant of "The End".

Unrefined, crude, and somewhat dense.
Although he is forceful, he faithfully follows the rules.
